items.exampleEn: Some people feel a compulsion to check their phones every minute.
items.exampleZh: 有些人每分鐘都忍不住想看手機。

items.exampleEn: Every old house has its quirks, like doors that won't close.
items.exampleZh: 每間老房子都有些怪毛病，像是關不上的門。

items.exampleEn: The toughness of this leather makes it last for years.
items.exampleZh: 這種皮革很堅韌，可以用好幾年。

items.exampleEn: He has a wry sense of humor.
items.exampleZh: 他有一種略帶挖苦的幽默感。

items.exampleEn: While she lived abroad, she had a craving for her mother's cooking.
items.exampleZh: 她住在國外時，非常想念媽媽煮的菜。

items.exampleEn: The exuberant fans danced in the streets after the win.
items.exampleZh: 球隊贏球後，興高采烈的球迷在街上跳起舞來。
items.glossZh: 熱情洋溢的；興高采烈的

items.exampleEn: The singer threw a tantrum when the sound system failed.
items.exampleZh: 音響系統故障時，那位歌手大發脾氣。

items.exampleEn: The lake was placid in the early morning.

items.sentenceEn: My little nephew had a tantrum in the supermarket.
items.sentenceZh: 我的小姪子在超市裡鬧脾氣。

items.audioEn: By a strange quirk of fate, I met my old teacher on a train in Japan.
items.audioZh: 命運真奇妙，我在日本的火車上遇到了以前的老師。
items.questionZh: 說話者在日本的火車上遇到了誰？
options: A famous movie star from Korea

items.sentenceEn: The puppy greeted us with exuberant barking.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻小狗興奮地汪汪叫著歡迎我們。

items.sentenceEn: She gave a wry smile when her plan failed again.
items.sentenceZh: 計畫又失敗時，她苦笑了一下。

items.stemEn: I had a sudden ____ for chocolate in the middle of the night.
items.stemZh: 我半夜突然很想吃巧克力。

items.stemEn: Unlike his loud brother, Sam is calm and ____.
items.stemZh: 不像他吵鬧的兄弟，Sam 沉著又溫和。

items.passageEn: Ms. Chang has taught five-year-olds for twenty years, and she says the job requires both patience and toughness. Parents happily trust her with their offspring. Every class has exuberant children who can't sit still and placid ones who quietly watch. Tantrums happen almost daily, but she never raises her voice. She has a few quirks of her own, such as wearing a different funny hat every Friday. When asked about her habits at work, she gave a wry smile and admitted to a small compulsion: she counts the children's coats twice before they go home. Her only craving after work is a cup of hot tea.
items.passageZh: 張老師教五歲的孩子已經二十年了，她說這份工作需要耐心，也需要堅韌。家長們都很放心把孩子交給她。每個班上都有坐不住、活力四射的孩子，也有安安靜靜在一旁看的溫和孩子。孩子鬧脾氣幾乎天天上演，但她從不提高音量。她自己也有幾個小怪癖，例如每個星期五都戴一頂不同的搞笑帽子。被問到工作上有什麼習慣時，她苦笑了一下，承認自己有個小小的強迫習慣：孩子們回家前，她一定要把外套數兩遍。她下班後唯一想要的，就是一杯熱茶。

questions.questionZh: 張老師說這份工作需要什麼？
她每個星期五會做什麼？

items.promptZh: 他的韌性讓他撐過了最艱難的一年。
referenceEn: His toughness helped him get through the hardest year.
Thanks to his toughness, he survived the most difficult year.
rubricZh: toughness 表示「堅韌、韌性」（例如 his toughness 等）
「撐過」可寫，例如 get through、survive 等
「最艱難的」可寫，例如 the hardest、the most difficult 等

items.promptZh: 我室友有個怪癖：他吃飯前一定要把盤子裡的食物排整齊。
referenceEn: My roommate has a strange quirk: he always arranges the food on his plate before he eats.
One of my roommate's quirks is that he must line up the food on his plate before eating.
rubricZh: 「怪癖」用 quirk（例如 has a quirk、one of his quirks 等）
「排整齊」可寫，例如 arranges、lines up 等
「一定要」可寫，例如 always、must、has to 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：lust 再次當干擾項（見 u10-l03、u10-l07），compulsion、lust 為名詞、與形容詞空格詞性不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: lust 換成 vicious（u10-l02 形容詞，與 calm 矛盾）；exuberant、vicious 放得進空格

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：she has a compulsion to keep learning from the children——compulsion 指難以控制的衝動、帶負面意味，用來說正向的學習熱忱不太自然（除非刻意自嘲）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: compulsion 改用於帶自嘲的強迫性小習慣："she still feels a compulsion to check every child's coat before they go home"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（情境句雷同）：改寫後的短文 feels a compulsion to check 與單字卡同句型
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 再改為 "she admitted to a small compulsion: she counts the children's coats twice before they go home."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：wry 釋義第一義「苦笑的」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「帶諷刺意味的；苦笑的」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：said she admitted 重複轉述，且問「漫長生涯」卻答數外套
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "When asked about her habits at work, she gave a wry smile and admitted to a small compulsion: …"，中譯同步「被問到工作上有什麼習慣時」
